maya: Heads up — TLS handshake error spike in sa-east-1 starting ~2026-02-12T07:03Z. Lots of 'short cert chain' and 'no cert presented' in ingress logs. Anyone triaging?
liam: I'm looking. rotator logs show 'issued cert' events but KMS audit has UnwrapDenied around the same time for rotator-sa-east.
nina: Confirmed: KMS audit at 2026-02-12T07:02:58Z shows permission denied for principal `serviceAccount:rotator-sa-east@redwood.iam`. Terraform cleanup PR removed a KMS binding for that key in that region.
maya: That matches. If rotator can't unwrap the CA key it can emit issuance but won't complete chain push, leaving proxies with invalid/stub certs. Quick mitigation: re-add kms:Decrypt to rotator SA and restart rotator.
liam: Patch applied via console (fast-path). KMS audit now shows Allow again.
rotator-bot: Restart queued: rotator-sa-east -> rolling restart started.
liam: Restart done. Rotator logs show successful unwrap + chain_pushed events. Handshake success improved to ~85% but a tail remains.
ops-bot: Suggest rolling edge proxies to clear cert caches: `kubectl -n ingress rollout restart deploy/edge-proxy --region=sa-east-1`.
nina: Rolling edge proxies now. Success rate to 99.4% after 6m.
maya: Root cause: accidental RBAC removal for rotator in terraform PR. Secondary: long cert cache TTL on some legacy proxies prolonged outage.
liam: Action items: 1) Terraform pre-apply guard to block removal of KMS unwrap perms for principals tagged 'rotator' or 'cert-issuer'; 2) Alert: KMS UnwrapDenied spike -> page sec-oncall; 3) Rotator change: validate unwrap before emitting 'issued' or mark issuance pending until unwrap confirmed; 4) Reduce cert-cache TTL during rotation windows (default 5m).
nina: Filing SEC ticket now.
liam: SEC-31021 created: "RBAC drift removed KMS unwrap -> mTLS handshake failures (sa-east-1)" https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-31021
maya: Thanks team — closing unless we see regressions. :thumbsup:
